status: partial final acceptance; integration and remaining checks pending
limitations: Synthetic temporary databases only; no personal conversation data.
Storage workloads overlapped regression-test activity; timings are observations, not isolated release thresholds.
Database/WAL peaks are sampled and include unreclaimed WAL; no VACUUM or historical compaction.
Headless desktop Chrome is not native Tauri IPC, a mobile device, or physical power-loss verification.
